rivers.note: Ash River descends from North Ridge and merges three tributaries at Forkflat.

mountains.note: Ridge exists, but rain shadow is missing; southern slope has identical climate.

cities.note: All three major towns sit along the old river trade road.

own_rules.note: Ash Season arrives every twelve years; local history tracks those cycles.

striking_elements.note: The Undying Lighthouse and the buried first city under the ash.

defines_identity.note: Lighthouse is strong; the rest lacks a unified tone.

depth_illusion.note: Was considering adding another ancient war to the Age of Ashes.

structural_gaps.note: If nobody can go outside during Ash Season, how does farming survive? Unanswered.

naming.note: Coastal towns use two syllables ending in hard stops (Gravelbay, Ironcrag).

visual_consistency.note: Lantern keepers wear copper, grey wool, and carry wick lamps.

silhouette.note: Beaked ash-mask and burlap cloak are unmistakable from afar.

core_anchor.note: Only defined for Lantern Keepers; inland farmers remain generic.

power_rules.note: Ash-calling only works in lantern light; exact cost is still vague.

power_destabilization.note: Power scale is already kept small.

beliefs_debates.note: Lantern oil is sacred, yet one starving fishing village cooks with it.

tradition_origins.note: Masks began as smoke protection in the first city; nobody remembers why anymore.

history_ripples.note: The first city fell, but borders and trade routes show no trace of it.

continuity.note: Coastal towns remain bound in debt by the Lantern Oath.

internal_contradiction.note: Mountain villages pay tax to the Lighthouse but refuse to swear by lantern light.

plural_narratives.note: Only Lighthouse chronicles exist so far.

place_names.note: Etymology of place names is out of scope for this project.
